7 years of professional level IT experience in various areas of expertise, seeking to leverage my technical, professional and domain knowledge in field of Data Science.
Working with large data sets - specific focus on data extraction, transformation, scraping, cleansing and data presentation.
Experience in Supervised and Unsupervised Machine Learning such as Regression, Classification, Clustering, Text mining, Bagging and Boosting techniques.
Understanding of Mathematical, Statistical and Theoretical basis of Machine Learning algorithms.
Knowledge on Statistical Machine learning models.
Experience with analytical programming languages, tools, and libraries (Python, SQL)
Understanding of Machine Learning Life Cycle - feature engineering, model training, model validation, deployment, and performance monitoring.
Understanding business problems and formulating them as data science problems.
Strong background in Statistical modeling: Probability Distribution, Business Decisions, Hypothesis Testing, Correlation, Regression, Confusion matrix, ROC.
Knowledge on various time series forecasting models: Seasonality and Trend.
Usage of CVAT tool for data annotations.
Knowledge and Hands-on experience on GenAI concepts, usage of RAG with LLMs and Gen AI frameworks like Langchain etc.
Knowledge of using Azure Machine learning studio and AI studio for training and finetuning of LLM models.

experience.company: Analyzed customer business use cases and designed end-to-end cloud architecture using Azure services to meet performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency requirements.
responsibilities: Acted as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expert guidance on Azure Cloud services, addressing technical queries, and delivering tailored cloud solutions aligned with business objectives.
Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning services, including AutoML, ML pipelines, compute instances/clusters, and environment configurations for streamlined model training and deployment.
Managed and configured Azure Blob Storage, implementing best practices for data management, security, and access patterns based on diverse customer use cases.
Assisted customers in setting up Managed Virtual Networks (VNet), and provided in-depth knowledge transfer sessions on custom VNet configurations and integration strategies.
Worked extensively with Azure OpenAI services to support customers in building and fine-tuning large language model (LLM) solutions for various business applications.
Responsible for analysing and providing the required insights for the following 3 KPIs:
Creating funnels using the data to calculate Recruit, Retain and Reclaim:
1. Performed data collection, data preparation, extraction of required fields and data exploration
2. Extracted the attributes required for value calculations of Funnels
Observe and forecast the trend:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data and checking for trends in 3R values
Forecasting goals for 3Rs:
1. Collecting previous 3-year data, check for seasonality and forecast 3R values for next year using time- series forecasting
All the development activities have been carried through Jupyter Notebook (python programming)
Deployment is carried on using AWS S3 and EC2.
Built a Machine learning model to forecast sales on various products
Data collected from client Database
Performed various EDA checks such as missing/incomplete data, Datatype checks and corrections, ACF, PACF, correlation checks, Statistical feature creation: Log, Lag, FFT (as applicable)
Forecasting was done at different levels
Various forecasting models have been checked and finally decided to use Prophet model
Compared the results with existing model and exhibited 15% more accurate model
Used Azure Machine learning studio to carry the development activities
Python programming language is used for all developmental activities
Worked on generation of medium, low, and high-level alerts for different KPIs.
Alerts on below scenarios:
Scenario 1: Shipments currently delayed (past due); alerts will be graded based on	no. of days past due Scenario 2: Shipments planned in the immediate future at risk of delay
Alert based on latest sales velocity (e.g., last 3-4 weeks) and demand gap
Alert based on significant difference between planned orders (Baseline) & optimizer recommended allocations
Forecasted sales velocity based on the past 3-year data using Time Series models
R programming is used for developmental activities
Azure Devops is used as Scrum platform
Worked to maximize the no. of 5G connections in different places of Denmark and predict which area might take more connections in future.
Collected the existing data from the customer and divided clusters based on different attributes
Used different clustering algorithms such as K-Means, DBSCAN Clustering etc.
200 clusters were taken, and prediction algorithms were applied on them to predict which area might take more connections in future.
Used prediction algorithms such as Decision tree, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Ensemble techniques etc.
Python programming is used for developmental activities
Developed different types of visualizations reports like bar charts and line charts.
Developed the reference lines in reports by using Parameters.
Publishing the reports to Tableau server.
Created data visualizations with different charts.
Deploying graphical visualizations in dashboards to create effective views of data such as: Line Charts, Bar Charts, Pie Charts, Tree Maps, Heat Maps, etc.

Title: Intelligent Document Question Answering using RAG Details:
Objective of the project is to ask questions (that are not included in the training data) about the document without finetuning the LLM and get the relevant answers
In this POC, I have used Langchain Framework and Chroma DB as vector database and llama-3-70B-Instruct model by meta.
All the coding and developmental activities are done with python programming integrated with VS Code, ensuring
Questions are processed through a retrieval step to fetch relevant documents from the vector store.
Retrieved context is passed to the LLM to generate precise answers, even for queries not seen during training.
No model fine-tuning was performed, demonstrating the power of RAG in zero-shot scenarios.

Successfully demonstrated the feasibility of using RAG with state-of-the-art LLMs for intelligent document Q&A, paving the way for scalable enterprise applications in knowledge management and automation.

Title: Intelligent Document Question Answering using RAG Details:
Objective of the project is to ask questions (that are not included in the training data) about the document without finetuning the LLM and get the relevant answers

Questions are processed through a retrieval step to fetch relevant documents from the vector store.
